qualifier: type III interferon and IL-20 family, wound repair
name: Epithelial interferon and IL-20 family cytokine responses
rationale: Members are interferon (alpha, lambda) and IL-20 family responses acting on epithelia plus wound-healing epithelial proliferation and anti-inflammatory control, distinguishing them from the IL-10/12/17/23 and IL-15/NK-cell confusables.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose donor synthesis and GPI anchoring
rationale: All members make dolichol, GDP-mannose and Dol-P-mannose (and their CDG defects) feeding GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables centred on ALG-driven lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly or UDP-GlcNAc.

name: Glutathione cycle and methylglyoxal-aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, catabolism, transport and its enzyme defects plus glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and ferroptosis restraint, which the transsulfuration, ROS and vitamin-B6 confusables lack.

name: Respiratory electron transport and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members are electron transport chain flux and oxidative phosphorylation with complex IV/respirasome assembly, whereas confusables emphasise complex III and ATP synthase assembly, inner-membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis subversion of host cell
name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis suppression of host cell defenses
rationale: All members are Mtb manoeuvres that suppress host autophagy, apoptosis, NO production, membrane repair, immunity and phagolysosome fusion, unlike confusables about iron assimilation or phagosome acidification.

name: Frizzled-LRP receptor regulation in canonical Wnt signaling
rationale: Members concern Wnt receptor-level events (LRP5, FZD ubiquitination by RNF43, ligand antagonists, DVL activation, destruction complex disassembly), distinct from nuclear beta-catenin/TCF and non-canonical or ligand-secretion confusables.

name: Tumor-suppressor gene transcription by RUNX3 and FOXO
rationale: Most members are transcriptional regulation of growth-restraining genes (CDKN1A, p14-ARF, BIM, PTEN, FOXO cell-cycle targets), with RUNX3 and FOXO distinguishing it from CDH1/TGF-beta transcription and RUNX3-WNT/YAP confusables.

name: Postsynaptic structural plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members cover postsynaptic density and actin organisation, structural plasticity and dendrite branching, distinct from confusables on filopodia, spine formation, BDNF-TRK and EPHB signalling.

name: Mammary alveolar development, lactation and involution
rationale: Members are mammary alveolar epithelial proliferation, differentiation, lactation and involution, whereas confusables concern mammary lineages, ductal branching and placental development.

core: Cranial sensory organ and nerve development
name: Ear, olfactory system and cranial nerve development
rationale: Members are inner/middle/outer ear, olfactory and cranial nerve/ganglion development with related neuron migration, distinguishing them from eye, craniofacial skeleton and gland confusables.

name: mRNA stabilization by IGF2BPs, decapping and nuclear processing
rationale: Members regulate mRNA turnover (stabilisation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, NMD) and nuclear splicing, export and 3'-end processing, with IGF2BP-mediated stabilisation set against confusables dominated by ARE-mediated destabilisation and stress granules.

name: Base excision repair gap filling, short and long patch
rationale: All members are the DNA synthesis/gap-filling steps of short- and long-patch base excision repair, unlike confusables on glycosylase recognition, replication or translesion synthesis.

core: Responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics
name: Ethanol, nicotine and anesthetic responses, agmatine-nitric oxide restraint
rationale: Members are cellular responses to neuroactive drugs (alcohol, nicotine, ether, anesthetics) plus agmatine synthesis and suppression of amine and NO biosynthesis, distinguishing them from antibiotic, chemotherapy and xenobiotic-response confusables.

name: Locomotion, exploration and grooming motor behavior
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming, reflex and proprioceptive behaviours with motor-relevant brain development, unlike confusables on glycinergic transmission, touch, vocalisation and learning.

Members are unrelated interaction-derived modules (mitochondrial housekeeping, RB1/BCL2L1, centrosomal proteins, Polycomb chromatin) plus a generic ubiquitination set, sharing no nameable biological theme.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity
name: NMDA receptor-CaMK-CREB signaling in plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and calcium/cAMP kinase cascades to CREB and NPAS4 transcription, LTP/LTD and memory, distinguishing them from kainate/AMPA channel activation and structural plasticity confusables.

name: RNA methylation and box C/D snoRNP-guided rRNA modification
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation including snoRNP C/D assembly and 2'-O-methylation, unlike confusables on rRNA cleavage/processing, pseudouridylation and mitochondrial RNA modification.

name: Mitochondrial protein targeting and membrane potential regulation
rationale: Members concern localisation and retention of proteins in mitochondria and control of membrane potential, distinct from apoptotic MOMP and mitophagy/fission confusables.

name: Respiratory electron transport and complex III-IV assembly
rationale: Members are electron transport chain flux with complex III/IV, respirasome assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion, whereas confusables carry complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial translation or Fe-S clusters.

name: Peptidyl lysine and arginine methylation and acetylation
rationale: Members are residue-level protein methylation and acetylation (including p53 and tubulin), distinct from confusables on chromatin remodeling complexes and histone methyltransferase complex assembly.

core: HGF-MET and TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling
name: HGF-MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with cancer mutants
rationale: Members are MET/HGF signalling and TGF-beta/activin/AMH receptor signalling including TGFBR3 and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, which the liver-development, PI3K/ALK and PTK6/EGFR confusables lack.

name: ER-centred intermembrane lipid and sterol transfer
rationale: Members transfer phospholipids, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol between the ER and other membranes with ER tethering, distinct from flippase, RAB, phospholipid catabolism and ER-mitochondria contact confusables.

name: piRNA transposon silencing and germline-to-zygote chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction, and maternal-to-zygotic transition, unlike confusables on PGC specification, imprinting or maternal mRNA decay.

name: G2/M progression and APC/C-driven mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover G2/M checkpoint and transition, APC/C and SCF-mediated cyclin degradation and mitotic exit, and DREAM repression, distinct from E2F/G1-S replication and spindle/cohesion confusables.

qualifier: phagosome maturation, iron acquisition, host subversion
name: Mycobacterial phagosome maturation, iron acquisition and host subversion
rationale: Members cover phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion, Mtb iron/heme acquisition and Mtb suppression of host defenses, unlike Listeria entry and neutrophil granule/peptide transport confusables.
